text: 你掰开伯纳德的手，把他摔在地上，诺曼则照料西尔维娅。你准备迎接再次袭击，他却突然跳起来，以惊人的速度冲向河边。
你犹豫不决，不知该向他开枪、追上去，还是先查看西尔维娅。伯纳德到了水边便一头扎进河里，再也没有浮上来。
你走到西尔维娅和诺曼身边。她的嘴唇已经发青。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 465
text: You break Bernard’s grip and throw him to the ground while Norman sees to Sylvia. You brace for a renewed attack, but instead, the mutilated student leaps to his feet and, with startling haste, dashes for the river.
You hesitate, torn between firing at him, following him, or checking on Sylvia. At the water’s edge, Bernard jumps in headfirst and does not emerge.
You go to Sylvia and Norman. Her lips are blue.
